raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-STP-YouthEmployment",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Extreme geographic insularity and isolation of Príncipe island (>170 km from São Tomé) could delay technical center construction and restrict logistics and service delivery.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish early logistics planning, prioritize local material sourcing, and maintain strong operational coordination with the Regional Government of Príncipe.",
      "evidence": "The other main island, Príncipe—home to just about 10,000 people—is more than 170 km away and experiences compounded isolation."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Frequent climate hazards such as flooding, severe storms, and sea level rise may disrupt project training schedules, damage facilities, and affect beneficiary livelihoods.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Apply climate-resilient design standards (including EDGE certification) for training infrastructure and embed climate adaptation practices into training curricula.",
      "evidence": "Key climate and disaster risks that may affect the project include floods, droughts, and rising sea levels."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Unreliable power grid infrastructure and extreme weather events could disrupt the operation of the new labor market information system and digital Employability Portal.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Procure backup power generators for systems infrastructure, adopt cloud-based data architecture, and enable offline-capable data entry solutions.",
      "evidence": "specifically intense rainfall and floods which may disrupt electricity access, the project will support the purchase of power generators"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Friction and coordination delays across multiple institutional stakeholders (MLSSS, MECSHE, MEYST, MAFRD, MEF, AFAP) could cause administrative bottlenecks and delayed workplans.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish a unified PIU under MLSSS and leverage a strategic Ministerial Coordination Committee to streamline inter-agency approvals and oversight.",
      "evidence": "delays in preparing annual workplans and implementing interventions due to the involvement of multiple stakeholders;"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Delays in recording financial transactions, generating reports, or completing timely internal audits at AFAP could undermine financial controls and trigger disbursement delays.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Appoint a dedicated project accountant, customize the computerized accounting system, update the FM manual, and expand external auditor scope within six months.",
      "evidence": "delays in recording financial transactions... internal audit reviews not conducted in a timely manner, leading to identification of weak controls"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Non-compliance with established eligibility criteria during beneficiary selection could cause delays or misallocations in availing sub-grants, stipends, and inclusion scholarships.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Leverage objective Unique Social Registry (USR) data for targeting, detail clear eligibility criteria in the POM, and contract a professional Payment Service Provider.",
      "evidence": "delays in availing funds for beneficiaries resulting from possible non-compliance in selection criteria."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Delays by MLSSS/DTEFP in supplying technical inputs, Terms of Reference, and specifications to AFAP could stall procurement processes for civil works, equipment, and consultancies.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Recruit specialized technical consultants (TVET specialist, IT assistant) into the unified PIU early and set service-level agreements for procurement inputs in the POM.",
      "evidence": "as the Ministry will need to provide technical inputs, including Terms of Reference and technical specifications, to allow AFAP to initiate procurement"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Social exclusion of disadvantaged youth, low-income women, or remote residents and potential elite capture could undermine equitable distribution of grants and scholarships.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Target at least 50% of beneficiaries from the USR, enforce 50% female participation quotas, and conduct inclusive community outreach via local women's associations.",
      "evidence": "risks of exclusion, which may arise if project benefits are not equitably distributed... as well as risks of elite capture"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Young female beneficiaries face potential sexual exploitation, abuse, and sexual harassment (SEA/SH) risks during training cohorts, internship placements, and work environments.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Appoint a dedicated Social/GBV Specialist, enforce binding codes of conduct across partner institutions and employers, and implement a confidential Grievance Redress Mechanism.",
      "evidence": "community health and safety risks, including risks of sexual exploitation and abuse (SEA) and sexual harassment (SH), particularly for young women"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Minor rehabilitation, new construction, and sub-grant-funded micro-enterprise activities could cause localized pollution, waste accumulation, or pressure on sensitive island ecosystems.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Appoint an Environmental Specialist with occupational health and safety expertise, enforce ESF screening for business sub-grants, and adopt strict construction waste protocols.",
      "evidence": "activities may result in the generation of solid waste... grants could support micro-enterprises in agriculture, fisheries, or tourism that may indirectly place pressure on sensitive ecosystems"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Limited domestic private sector absorption capacity in STP's small economy may impede trained youth from securing sustained wage employment.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Combine skills training with self-employment starter packages, MSME booster grants, and structured labor mobility pathways to expand job opportunities abroad.",
      "evidence": "Micro and small enterprises make up 92 percent of all firms... mostly household-run and provide few job opportunities... limited absorption capacity of the domestic labor market"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "High youth desire for emigration (68%) combined with unstructured migration channels could result in brain drain, worker exploitation abroad, and reduced project retention.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Integrate safe, market-aligned labor mobility orientation modules, partner with key destination countries (e.g., Portugal), and link Employability Portal with overseas job options.",
      "evidence": "68 percent of youth are considering leaving... emigration has yielded limited economic benefits... migrants end up in precarious jobs with low wages"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Failure to recruit key legal covenant specialists (Environmental, Social/GBV, TVET, IT) within 45 to 60 days post-effectiveness could delay project startup.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Initiate TOR drafting and recruitment preparation during the pre-effectiveness window to ensure rapid appointment post-effectiveness.",
      "evidence": "hire or appoint, not later than forty-five (45) days after Effectiveness: (i) one Environmental Specialist... (ii) one Social Specialist..."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Construction cost overruns and material price inflation for the new technical training center in Príncipe could exceed the preliminary $5 million budget allocation.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Complete detailed engineering designs and local cost studies early, and manage potential budget adjustments dynamically within the project procurement plan.",
      "evidence": "The cost estimate for the new center is based on preliminary technical inputs... Adjustments will be managed within project's procurement plan"
    }
  ]
}

risks.description: Extreme geographic insularity and isolation of Príncipe island (>170 km from São Tomé) could delay technical center construction and restrict logistics and service delivery.
